title: JyGlobalVST Preset (.jvst)
description: User-portable plugin-chain preset. Persisted at %UserProfile%\Documents\JyGlobalVST\Presets\*.jvst. Validated strictly on import per FR-022g-1.

schema_version.description: Currently 1. Incremented on incompatible schema changes (FR-022b).

target_sample_rate.description: Advisory only — runtime negotiates with hardware endpoint.

target_device_friendly_name.description: Advisory; resolved per FR-022m priority chain on load.

plugin_uid.description: VST3 class UID (TUID) — 16 bytes as a 32-character hex string.

plugin_path_hint.description: Display-only hint. Host MUST NOT load a plugin binary from this path; resolution is by (uid, vendor, name) only per FR-022g-2.

tag.description: Optional user-assigned label shown beside the plugin name. Absent or empty means untagged.

shortcut.description: True when this slot owns one of the two tray popup quick-toggle buttons. At most two slots may set it.

state_chunk_b64.description: Base64-encoded VST3 state. Decoded size MUST NOT exceed 16 MB (FR-022g-1). 22369622 chars ≈ 16 MB decoded.

validation_rules: FR-022g-1: reject unknown top-level fields (additionalProperties:false enforces this).
FR-022g-1: enforce 50 MB file-size cap (checked before parse).
FR-022g-1: enforce per-state-chunk 16 MB decoded cap (checked after base64-decode).
FR-022g-1: reject unrecognized schema_version unless migratable (FR-022b).
slot positions MUST form contiguous range [0..N-1]; checked post-parse.
FR-022g-2: plugin_path_hint is informational only and MUST NOT be used to load binaries.
